title: A second member with the same email is rejected, whatever its case
when: Registers a member, then registers another with the same email in a different case and with spaces.
then: Refused as `email_taken`, by the command handler and by `MemberRepository.add` on its own. Inserting the duplicate straight into the members table also fails.

title: A tool needing repair keeps its damage report until it is marked repaired
when: Lends a tool, reports damage on it during the loan, reports damage on it again and returns the loan as `good`; then marks the tool repaired, borrows it again and reports new damage.
then: The second damage report is refused as `tool_already_damaged` and the first report stands. The loan records `good`, but the tool stays `needs_repair` with its first report and cannot be borrowed. Once a librarian marks it repaired, it is `good` with no report, can be borrowed, and damage can be reported on it again.

title: A tool on loan cannot be lent again until it is returned
when: Lends a tool to one member, has a second member borrow it and saves a second active loan for it straight through `LoanRepository.add`; then returns the first loan and has the second member borrow again.
then: A second member borrowing a tool on loan is refused as `tool_on_loan`; a second active loan saved without the aggregate's check fails on the table's unique key; after the return the second member can borrow.

title: A loan is due 14 calendar days after it starts, in the library's time zone
when: Lends a tool at the test clock's start in New York; with the library in Auckland, lends one at 01:00 on 3 March Auckland time; then saves a loan whose due date is a time through `LoanRepository.add`.
then: The loan starts at the clock time and is due on the New York date 14 days later. With the library in Auckland, the same loan is due on the Auckland date. The database refuses a due date that is not a date.

title: A returned loan cannot be returned again
when: Lends a tool, returns it as `good`, then returns it again as `needs_repair`.
then: A second return of the same loan is refused as `already_returned`, and the loan keeps its first return.

title: A return records the tool's condition on the loan
when: Lends a tool and, three days later, returns it as `needs_repair` with the note `Blade chipped`.
then: The loan, loaded again, holds the return time, the condition and the note.

title: A loan renewed once cannot be renewed again
when: Lends a tool, renews the loan 10 days in, then renews it again.
then: The first renewal moves the due date from 16 to 30 March and raises Loan renewed; the second is refused as `already_renewed`, and the loan keeps its first renewal.

title: A loan's member is reminded once, and never after the return
when: Lends a tool and reminds its member, renews the loan and reminds them again; lends another tool, returns it and reminds its member.
then: The first reminder is recorded and raises Member reminded; a second, after the renewal, is refused as `already_reminded`; a returned loan is refused as `already_returned` and is never reminded.
